title: Impact of Markov Decision Process Design on Sim-to-Real Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2603.09427v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has demonstrated strong potential for industrial process control, yet policies trained in simulation often suffer from a significant sim-to-real gap when deployed on physical hardware. This work systematically analyzes how core Markov Decision Process (MDP) design choices -- state composition, target inclusion, reward formulation, termination criteria, and environment dynamics models -- affect this transfer. Using a color mixing task, we evaluate different MDP configurations and mixing dynamics across simulation and real-world experiments. We validate our findings on physical hardware, demonstrating that physics-based dynamics models achieve up to 50% real-world success under strict precision constraints where simplified models fail entirely. Our results provide practical MDP design guidelines for deploying RL in industrial process control.

translated_title: 马尔可夫决策过程设计对模拟到真实强化学习迁移的影响
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）在工业过程控制中展现出强大潜力，然而在仿真中训练的策略部署到物理硬件时，往往会面临显著的模拟到现实差距。本工作系统分析了核心马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）设计选择——状态构成、目标纳入、奖励设计、终止条件以及环境动力学模型——如何影响这种迁移。我们以颜色混合任务为例，在仿真与真实世界实验中评估了不同的MDP配置和混合动力学。我们在物理硬件上验证了研究结果，证明基于物理的动力学模型在严格精度约束下可实现高达50%的真实世界成功率，而简化模型则完全失败。我们的结果为在工业过程控制中部署强化学习提供了实用的MDP设计指南。
tldr: 该论文系统研究了MDP核心设计选择（状态构成、奖励、终止条件、动力学模型）对强化学习模拟到现实迁移的影响，并通过颜色混合任务证明基于物理的动力学模型在严格精度约束下可实现50%的真实成功率。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically analyzes how core MDP design choices affect sim-to-real transfer in reinforcement learning, demonstrating that physics-based dynamics models achieve up to 50% real-world success under strict precision constraints where simplified models fail entirely.
